---
title: Stuffed Zucchini Flowers
id: MAR-0033
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 16 zucchini flowers
- 300 g boiled veal
- 1 whole egg + 1 egg yolk
- 1 spring onion
- 2 tablespoons chopped parsley
- 2 tablespoons grated Grana Padano
- to taste frying oil,
- to taste salt,
## Method
1. Wash the zucchini flowers, removing the pistil, and place them on a cloth.
2. Pass the meat through the meat grinder and collect it in a bowl, adding the parsley, chopped spring onion, egg and yolk.
3. Salt and mix the ingredients well.
4. Stuff the zucchini flowers with a small ball of the mixture and fry them in hot oil, a few at a time, for a few minutes.
5. Drain them, place them on kitchen paper, and serve hot.
